end.summary:
Practised neutralisation in daily life: ant bites, antacids, soil, toothpaste and factory waste.
Explained that an acid and base form salt and water and release heat.
Compared neutralisation with dilution using indicators; identified green as neutral with universal indicator.
Initially mixed up acid–base reactions with poison formation; corrected this during the lesson using lime and soil treatment.
end.parentNote: Khushi practised applying neutralisation to everyday examples and explaining the products formed. They used the useful idea that lime can reduce soil acidity and that too much lime can make soil basic. A mix-up about every acid–base reaction forming poison was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Khushi to sort examples into “neutralisation” or “dilution” and explain what an indicator would show.
